summary: Foundation confirmation pass for CUGO App. Backend: 3/3 pytest cases pass — GET /api/health returns 200 with {status:ok, service:cugo-api, database:connected, environment:development}; GET /api returns 200 with {service:cugo-api, status:running, version:0.1.0}; PostgreSQL contains both 'branches' and 'alembic_version' tables (verified via psql). Frontend: landing page loads at root, brand shows 'CUGO App' with 'Multi-branch laundry management' eyebrow, System Status card renders 'API service: Online' and 'Database (PostgreSQL): Connected', and env-pill shows 'development'. No business features exist by design and none were tested.
critical_code_review_comments: health.py swallows all exceptions with broad `except Exception` returning 'disconnected' but still HTTP 200 — acceptable for a health endpoint but consider logging the exception for future debuggability.
backend/.env exposes POSTGRES_* individually while no DATABASE_URL is present — ensure app/core/config.py builds the async URL consistently (verified via runtime connectivity).
Frontend App.tsx has a single API call with a generic catch — sufficient for foundation; when business features are added, add retry/backoff and surface error details.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Foundation is green. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_foundation.py can be re-run as regression. Next iterations will add business features (branches CRUD, auth, etc.) — extend this file rather than creating new ones for the same layer.
